target.title: fix: allow configuring Slack App Home copy
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where branded Slack apps still publish the default OpenClaw App Home copy. In the reported before state, a branded Slack app header used custom app copy, but the Home tab body still said `OpenClaw` and told users to use `/openclaw`, which makes configured app branding and command paths look broken.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a Slack `appHome` config block at the root and per-account level so operators can customize the safe App Home title, description, and footer, or disable Home tab publishing entirely. The default behavior remains unchanged for existing installs, and the fallback usage line now reflects the configured `slashCommand.name` when no custom description is provided.

## User Impact

Slack operators can now make the App Home tab match their app name and slash command, such as `Acme Corp Assistant` with `/acme`, without forking the Slack plugin. Existing users keep the current OpenClaw Home tab copy unless they opt into the new config.

## Evidence

Before evidence from a reported Slack App Home screenshot: the app header showed custom branding, while the Home tab rendered `OpenClaw` and instructed users to use `/openclaw`.

Validation run locally from branch `fix/slack-app-home-config`:

```text
pnpm test -- extensions/slack/src/monitor/events/home.test.ts extensions/slack/src/config-schema.test.ts
✓ extensions/slack/src/monitor/events/home.test.ts (6 tests)
✓ extensions/slack/src/config-schema.test.ts (25 tests)
Test Files 2 passed; Tests 31 passed
```

Additional checks:

```text
pnpm exec oxfmt --check docs/channels/slack.md extensions/slack/src/config-schema.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/context.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/events/home.test.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/events/home.ts extensions/slack/src/monitor/provider.ts src/config/types.slack.ts src/config/zod-schema.providers-core.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

git diff --check
# no output
```

Known local proof gap: full local lint/build was not run. The worktree did not have its own `node_modules`; `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` is currently blocked by an existing patchedDependencies lockfile mismatch, and the lint wrapper then failed while preparing plugin-SDK boundary artifacts because `markdown-it-cjk-friendly` could not be resolved from the borrowed modules dir.
